ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Nov-17-2005 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Judge Gerald Ragan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Helen Sorep-Matley.
Petitioner: Shirley Wang, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Joane lauren Cam, was sworn and examined.
Proof of Service on Notice of OSC. for Change of Name to Minor's Father: Vinson Cam, received and filed in court,
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minor to: Joanne Lauren Wang.
Decree signed in open court.
